jobs.description: Careers at Bluebricks | Join Our Team About Blog Docs Login See Bluebricks Live Login See Bluebricks Live Careers / Marketing Next.js Engineer Freelance Come join Bluebricks, a company that's reinventing how teams manage cloud infrastructure in today's AI era. At Bluebricks, we're on a mission to make cloud infrastructure automation ready for Agentic AI. We're a remote-first company with a culture that values clear communication, a hunger to win, and a customer-first mindset. With a rapidly growing customer base and a pipeline fueled by word of mouth across the globe, we're excited to open a new opportunity. SUMMARY We’re looking for a Next.js engineer to partner with us on marketing studio activities. This role is a great fit for someone who's obsessed with pixel-perfect development, passionate about clean and high-performing code, and enjoys building beautiful web experiences with creative freedom. What You'll Own Development and maintenance of our company website and other marketing assets — including landing pages, popup campaigns, and interactive visual components Ownership of our Vercel account and associated projects Management of our Strapi CMS instance and content workflows Execution of responsive, performance-optimized, SEO-friendly builds that reflect design precision and brand tone What You’ll Need to Succeed Proven experience with building outstanding websites or frontend projects Deep passion for CSS, design systems, and web performance Excellent communication skills with designers, stakeholders, and team members — async and in-person Strong understanding of UX across audiences — CMS users, website visitors, and search engines High ownership mindset with the ability to commit to timelines and deliverables Familiarity with Agentic AI concepts and hands-on experience with tools like Claude Code (or similar) Don’t forget to mention if you have: A portfolio of websites or digital assets you’ve built (or contributed to in a studio setting) Experience working directly with early-stage startup founders Cool side projects, open-source contributions, or leadership experience that showcases initiative and people skills Bluebricks is on a mission to redefine cloud infrastructure provisioning and make it at the speed of AI. jobs.title: Review Requirements
jobs.description: Careers at Bluebricks | Join Our Team About Blog Docs Login See Bluebricks Live Login See Bluebricks Live Careers / Engineering Senior Backend Engineer Location : Tel-Aviv, Hybrid, Full-time | Team Size : Small, Agile R&D Today, AI stops at the code layer because infrastructure context is fragmented and inaccessible. Bluebricks maps your cloud resources, their relationships, and your organizational guardrails into a unified, structured layer. This allows agents to discover what exists, understand how everything is connected, and execute infrastructure tasks reliably. Instead of giving agents direct, risky access to cloud APIs, they operate through Bluebricks, which handles orchestration, dependency management, policy enforcement, and auditability. The result: AI agents that can complete infrastructure tasks end-to-end, safely, deterministically, and without human handoffs. The Role We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is excited about modern development workflows, including AI-assisted engineering. You will work across product, infrastructure, and platform components to build the next generation of cloud infrastructure tooling. This is a great opportunity for a senior with strong engineering fundamentals to impact and push our SDLC and execution to the next level. Your Impact & Mission Architect systems and break down complex infrastructure workflows Build and own backend and platform components end-to-end Leverage AI tools to accelerate development and improve productivity Evaluate and improve development workflows, including AI-assisted approaches Collaborate closely with product, founders, and customers Your Experience, Mindset, and Skills 6+ years of Backend-oriented engineering experience, preferably in startups Strong understanding of system design and distributed systems Experience using modern development tools, including AI coding assistants (Cursor, Copilot, Claude, etc.) Interest in exploring and improving AI-assisted engineering workflows Ability to work in a fast-changing and agile startup environment High ownership mindset, curiosity, open-mindedness, and bias toward action Experience working with Go and/or TypeScript Experience working with PostgreSQL or other relational databases Experience working with caching systems (e.g., Redis, Memcached, or similar) It can be a great plus if you have Experience working with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or OpenTofu) Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI agents into software workflows Experience working with Kubernetes Experience working with Graph databases (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) Experience working in early-stage startups What’s in it for you Opportunity to define how AI agents build and operate cloud infrastructure Work on a technically challenging DevOps and platform problem Small team with high ownership and impact Apply CV Follow Bluebricks on Linkedin Share Home Book a Demo Careers Available on AWS Available on Google Cloud Available on Azure ©2026 Bluebricks Ltd.
